warnings: Grid bubbles are printed on every structural plan: 1-9 along x (8 bays x 4.50 = 36.00, total printed) and A-C along y (A-B 6.00, B-C 3.00, total 9.00). Origin A1 (top-left as drawn). All four plans (S-01..S-04) agree on these values.

Dummy lines: every printed tick on the five structural plans is a line (§4 rule 4). y before origin and in the A-B gap share A's prime sequence in reading order: A' -1.60 (eave), A'' -1.23 (GS slab edge), A''' -0.83 (corridor slab S2 edge, printed '~0.83'), A'''' 2.40, A''''' 3.00 (B4 beam line), A'''''' 4.50. B-C gap: B' 6.60, B'' 7.60 (truss reinforcement-lap tick, S-05), B''' 8.27 (B5 line, '~0.73' above C). After C: C' 9.73 (S1 edge, '~0.73'), C'' 10.60 (eave). x: 1' -1.20 (eave), 1'' -1.18 (GS edge), 1''' -0.68 (S1 edge, '~0.68'); 9' 36.68, 9'' 37.20 (eave).

1' (-1.20, eave line on S-04) and 1'' (-1.18, GS ground-slab edge on S-02) are 0.02 apart. They are different edges printed on different sheets (eave vs ground slab), so both are kept per §4 rule 4, not merged.
Several values are printed with a tilde ('~0.83', '~0.73', '~0.68') — the drawing itself marks them approximate. pos_m uses the printed number.

9' (36.68) is NOT printed: it is the end of the short cantilever BC at B9 on floors 1-2, scaled from the drawing (~0.68) and matching the printed '~0.68' on the grid-1 side (1'''). Kept as a scaled dummy with its own confidence so the BC stub has an endpoint (beam-endpoint rule). C' (9.73) is printed on S-04 (S1 slab edge); the BC stubs at C2/C8 on floors 1-2 scale to ~0.70 and are recorded against C'.

z_levels: the only labelled level is the ±0.00 building datum (S-01 note). Every other level is a member-top value printed in brackets next to a beam/slab mark on the plans (+0.10 ... +7.17) — ids are the printed value, type dummy.

Dimension sweep covers the five structural plans S-01..S-05 (pages 17-21) plus the truss elevations of S-06 (page 22), the level marks of S-12 (page 28) and the stair elevations of S-13 (page 29, x ticks 1'''' 1.22 / 1''''' 1.60 / 1'''''' 1.68 / 1''''''' 4.30 from grid 1 — drawn for the grid 1-2 stair only; the mirrored grid 8-9 stair prints none). The architectural sheets (A-01..A-15) and the detail sheets S-07..S-11 were not swept for grid ticks in this op04 run (shutdown deadline) — their dimensions are not in this file (element-internal dimensions of the extracted detail sheets live on their elements). The two beam-spacing rows of S-12's 'ขยายระดับ พื้นและคาน' (2.35/3.05/3.10 and 3.05/3.05/3.10, measured between beam faces/edges that do not add up to the 9.00 grid) are kept as unpositioned 'edge' chains rather than guessed onto lines. The stair tread note on S-02/S-03 ('20 x 0.18 = ...', too small to read reliably at this scan) is likewise not transcribed.
Scanned CAD-plotted government set (กองออกแบบและก่อสร้าง สำนักอำนวยการ สพฐ.); every value was read off zoomed crops of the page images.

dummy_grid_rule_check.negative_pos_m: x 1' -1.20, 1'' -1.18, 1''' -0.68; y A' -1.60, A'' -1.23, A''' -0.83 — before-origin dummies share the first main grid's prime sequence with the dummies in the gap after it.
